title: VTG Blefeld Floral Etched Liqueur Shot Glass Delicate Wheel-Cut - Heavy Bottom
descriptionText: The VTG Blefeld Floral Etched Liqueur Shot Glass is a delicate and detailed piece featuring a beautiful flower pattern etched onto the clear glass. With a heavy bottom design, this shot glass is perfect for enjoying a small pour of your favorite spirits. Its vintage design adds a touch of elegance to any barware collection, making it a unique and eye-catching addition to your kitchen or home decor.
